queries.sql: SELECT date_bin($3::interval, start_time_unix_nano) AS at, count(*) AS spans FROM bifrost.traces.spans WHERE start_time_unix_nano >= $1::timestamptz AND start_time_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz GROUP BY date_bin($3::interval, start_time_unix_nano) ORDER BY at

SELECT date_bin($3::interval, start_time_unix_nano) AS at, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 2) AS errors FROM bifrost.traces.spans WHERE start_time_unix_nano >= $1::timestamptz AND start_time_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz GROUP BY date_bin($3::interval, start_time_unix_nano) ORDER BY at

SELECT date_bin($3::interval, start_time_unix_nano) AS at, approx_percentile_cont(duration_nano, 0.95) / 1e6 AS p95, approx_percentile_cont(duration_nano, 0.5) / 1e6 AS p50 FROM bifrost.traces.spans WHERE start_time_unix_nano >= $1::timestamptz AND start_time_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz AND parent_span_id IS NULL GROUP BY date_bin($3::interval, start_time_unix_nano) ORDER BY at

SELECT count(*) AS spans, count(DISTINCT trace_id) AS traces, count(DISTINCT trace_id) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 2) AS error_traces, approx_percentile_cont(duration_nano, 0.95) / 1e6 AS span_p95_ms FROM bifrost.traces.spans WHERE start_time_unix_nano >= $1::timestamptz AND start_time_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz

SELECT recorded_at, verifier_card_uid, subject_name, run_id, group_id, service_name, status, verdict, execution_id, subject_kind, subject_version, subject_card_uid, result_id, binding_id, workload_card_uid FROM (SELECT i.execution_id, i.recorded_at, i.verifier_card_uid, i.binding_id, i.group_id, i.origin, i.run_id, i.subject_kind, i.subject_name, i.subject_version, i.subject_card_uid, i.workload_card_uid, i.service_name, i.service_version, i.deployment_environment, r.result_id, r.verdict, r.ended_at, CASE WHEN i.origin = 'direct' THEN CASE WHEN r.result_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE 'not recorded' END ELSE coalesce(q.status, 'pending') END AS status FROM bifrost.verification.execution_inputs i LEFT JOIN (SELECT execution_id, last_value(status ORDER BY occurred_at, event_id) AS status FROM bifrost.verification.execution_events WHERE event = 'status' AND occurred_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY execution_id) q ON q.execution_id = i.execution_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.execution_id, e.value -> 'terminal' ->> 'result_id' AS result_id FROM bifrost.verification.execution_events e JOIN (SELECT execution_id, max(sequence) AS sequence FROM bifrost.verification.execution_events WHERE event = 'checkpoint' AND occurred_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY execution_id) l ON l.execution_id = e.execution_id AND l.sequence = e.sequence WHERE e.event = 'checkpoint' AND e.occurred_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour') s ON s.execution_id = i.execution_id LEFT JOIN bifrost.verification.results r ON r.execution_id = i.execution_id AND r.ended_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND (i.origin = 'direct' OR r.result_id = s.result_id)) AS executions WHERE recorded_at >= $1::timestamptz AND recorded_at < $2::timestamptz ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, execution_id ASC LIMIT 51

SELECT time_unix_nano, severity_text, service_name, body_text, exception_type, encode(trace_id, 'hex') AS trace_id, encode(span_id, 'hex') AS span_id, observed_time_unix_nano, wyrd_request_id, severity_number FROM bifrost.logs.records WHERE time_unix_nano >= $1::timestamptz AND time_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz ORDER BY time_unix_nano DESC, observed_time_unix_nano ASC, wyrd_request_id ASC LIMIT 51

SELECT date_bin($3::interval, time_unix_nano) AS at, CASE WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 'error' WHEN severity_number >= 13 THEN 'warn' WHEN severity_number >= 9 THEN 'info' WHEN severity_number >= 1 THEN 'debug' ELSE 'unset' END AS level, count(*) AS records FROM bifrost.logs.records WHERE time_unix_nano >= $1::timestamptz AND time_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz GROUP BY date_bin($3::interval, time_unix_nano), CASE WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 'error' WHEN severity_number >= 13 THEN 'warn' WHEN severity_number >= 9 THEN 'info' WHEN severity_number >= 1 THEN 'debug' ELSE 'unset' END ORDER BY at

SELECT metric_name, metric_type, unit FROM bifrost.metrics.series WHERE hour_unix_nano >= date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', $1::timestamptz) AND hour_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz GROUP BY metric_name, metric_type, unit ORDER BY metric_name, metric_type, unit LIMIT 51

WITH pts AS (SELECT date_bin($4::interval, time_unix_nano) AS w, time_unix_nano AS t, start_time_unix_nano AS s, series_id, metric_type, unit, aggregation_temporality, is_monotonic, CAST(int_value AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS i, COALESCE(CAST(int_value AS DOUBLE), double_value) AS x FROM bifrost.metrics.points WHERE time_unix_nano >= $1::timestamptz AND time_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz AND metric_name = $3 AND metric_type IN ('gauge', 'sum')), steps AS (SELECT *, lag(t) OVER series IS NULL AS head, lag(s) OVER series AS sp, lag(x) OVER series AS xp, lag(i) OVER series AS ip FROM pts WINDOW series AS (PARTITION BY series_id ORDER BY t)), ends AS (SELECT w, series_id, metric_type, unit, aggregation_temporality, is_monotonic, sum(x) AS xt, last_value(x ORDER BY t) AS x1, sum(CASE WHEN head THEN CASE WHEN s < $1::timestamptz THEN 0 ELSE x END WHEN s = sp AND x >= xp THEN x - xp ELSE x END) AS xd, sum(i) AS it, last_value(i ORDER BY t) AS i1, sum(CASE WHEN head THEN CASE WHEN s < $1::timestamptz THEN 0 ELSE i END WHEN s = sp AND i >= ip THEN i - ip ELSE i END) AS id, bool_and(i IS NOT NULL AND (head OR ip IS NOT NULL)) AS exact FROM steps GROUP BY w, series_id, metric_type, unit, aggregation_temporality, is_monotonic), per AS (SELECT w, encode(series_id, 'hex') AS series, metric_type, unit, aggregation_temporality, is_monotonic, CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 1 THEN xt WHEN metric_type = 'sum' AND is_monotonic THEN xd ELSE x1 END AS v, CASE WHEN exact THEN CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 1 THEN it WHEN metric_type = 'sum' AND is_monotonic THEN id ELSE i1 END END SELECT start_time_unix_nano, name, service_name, duration_nano, status_code, encode(trace_id, 'hex') AS trace_id, encode(span_id, 'hex') AS span_id FROM bifrost.traces.spans WHERE start_time_unix_nano >= $1::timestamptz AND start_time_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz AND parent_span_id IS NULL AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM bifrost.traces.spans WHERE start_time_unix_nano >= $1::timestamptz AND start_time_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz AND service_name = $3) ORDER BY start_time_unix_nano DESC, encode(trace_id, 'hex') ASC, encode(span_id, 'hex') ASC LIMIT 51

SELECT recorded_at, verifier_card_uid, subject_name, run_id, group_id, service_name, status, verdict, execution_id, subject_kind, subject_version, subject_card_uid, result_id, binding_id, workload_card_uid FROM (SELECT i.execution_id, i.recorded_at, i.verifier_card_uid, i.binding_id, i.group_id, i.origin, i.run_id, i.subject_kind, i.subject_name, i.subject_version, i.subject_card_uid, i.workload_card_uid, i.service_name, i.service_version, i.deployment_environment, r.result_id, r.verdict, r.ended_at, CASE WHEN i.origin = 'direct' THEN CASE WHEN r.result_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE 'not recorded' END ELSE coalesce(q.status, 'pending') END AS status FROM bifrost.verification.execution_inputs i LEFT JOIN (SELECT execution_id, last_value(status ORDER BY occurred_at, event_id) AS status FROM bifrost.verification.execution_events WHERE event = 'status' AND occurred_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY execution_id) q ON q.execution_id = i.execution_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.execution_id, e.value -> 'terminal' ->> 'result_id' AS result_id FROM bifrost.verification.execution_events e JOIN (SELECT execution_id, max(sequence) AS sequence FROM bifrost.verification.execution_events WHERE event = 'checkpoint' AND occurred_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY execution_id) l ON l.execution_id = e.execution_id AND l.sequence = e.sequence WHERE e.event = 'checkpoint' AND e.occurred_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour') s ON s.execution_id = i.execution_id LEFT JOIN bifrost.verification.results r ON r.execution_id = i.execution_id AND r.ended_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND (i.origin = 'direct' OR r.result_id = s.result_id)) AS executions WHERE recorded_at >= $1::timestamptz AND recorded_at < $2::timestamptz AND status = $3 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, execution_id ASC LIMIT 51

SELECT recorded_at, verifier_card_uid, subject_name, run_id, group_id, service_name, status, verdict, execution_id, subject_kind, subject_version, subject_card_uid, result_id, binding_id, workload_card_uid FROM (SELECT i.execution_id, i.recorded_at, i.verifier_card_uid, i.binding_id, i.group_id, i.origin, i.run_id, i.subject_kind, i.subject_name, i.subject_version, i.subject_card_uid, i.workload_card_uid, i.service_name, i.service_version, i.deployment_environment, r.result_id, r.verdict, r.ended_at, CASE WHEN i.origin = 'direct' THEN CASE WHEN r.result_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE 'not recorded' END ELSE coalesce(q.status, 'pending') END AS status FROM bifrost.verification.execution_inputs i LEFT JOIN (SELECT execution_id, last_value(status ORDER BY occurred_at, event_id) AS status FROM bifrost.verification.execution_events WHERE event = 'status' AND occurred_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY execution_id) q ON q.execution_id = i.execution_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.execution_id, e.value -> 'terminal' ->> 'result_id' AS result_id FROM bifrost.verification.execution_events e JOIN (SELECT execution_id, max(sequence) AS sequence FROM bifrost.verification.execution_events WHERE event = 'checkpoint' AND occurred_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY execution_id) l ON l.execution_id = e.execution_id AND l.sequence = e.sequence WHERE e.event = 'checkpoint' AND e.occurred_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour') s ON s.execution_id = i.execution_id LEFT JOIN bifrost.verification.results r ON r.execution_id = i.execution_id AND r.ended_at >= $1::timestamptz - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND (i.origin = 'direct' OR r.result_id = s.result_id)) AS executions WHERE recorded_at >= $1::timestamptz AND recorded_at < $2::timestamptz AND verdict = $3 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, execution_id ASC LIMIT 51

SELECT start_time_unix_nano, name, service_name, duration_nano, status_code, encode(trace_id, 'hex') AS trace_id, encode(span_id, 'hex') AS span_id FROM bifrost.traces.spans WHERE start_time_unix_nano >= $1::timestamptz AND start_time_unix_nano < $2::timestamptz AND parent_span_id IS NULL AND (start_time_unix_nano < $3::timestamptz OR (start_time_unix_nano = $3::timestamptz AND (encode(trace_id, 'hex') > $4 OR (encode(trace_id, 'hex') = $4 AND (encode(span_id, 'hex') > $5))))) ORDER BY start_time_unix_nano DESC, encode(trace_id, 'hex') ASC, encode(span_id, 'hex') ASC LIMIT 51
